title: dev.matrixmedia.room_config
description: The MM-room marker (ADR-0011 section 3), content version 2. State event, state key "". Written by the MatrixMedia server's bot when it joins a room, on enable-mm, when the room owner switches MatrixMedia on or off, and at stream start; never read back by the server, and it grants nothing. Its name is never changed by a setting. A client uses mm_server_url only if it is the server the user is signed in to, or the federation trust check for mm_matrix_server passes.

enabled.description: false when the room owner switched MatrixMedia off; clients hide MatrixMedia features.

mm_server_url.description: Base URL of the MatrixMedia server that runs the room.

mm_matrix_server.description: Matrix server name of that MatrixMedia server.

write.description: "legacy" or a namespace listed in read.

event_namespaces.description: The server's event_namespaces block, the same one POST /auth/token returns. Clients honour it only when the marker passes the trust check and its power level is pinned (ADR-0011 section 4, rules 6 and 8).
